function: Learned constellation design (autoencoder) for uplink bi-static ISAC, trading symbol error rate against sensing sidelobe level; learned transformer demodulator at the BS (p. 1-3).
system: MIMO-OFDM uplink, UE with Nt and BS with Nr antennas (ULA), 64-point constellation, no RIS; antenna numbers and frequency band not stated (p. 1-2).
method: Autoencoder, supervised end-to-end: four-layer linear DNN encoder at UE, four-layer one-head transformer demodulator at BS; loss mixes cross-entropy and fourth-moment ASL term (p. 2-3).
data_channel: Custom simulated multipath channel (L paths with gain, delay, Doppler, AoA/AoD, ULA); 1000 random realizations per SNR; no standard model or public dataset (p. 2, 4).
test_conditions: Training on one fixed channel realisation; testing on channel parameters perturbed by 1.5% Gaussian error (CSI error), SNR 0-20 dB (p. 3-4).
baselines: 64-QAM and 64-PSK constellations (non-learned); no earlier learned constellation or ISAC method compared (p. 4-5).
metrics: Symbol error rate vs SNR and weight factor, fourth moment (E{rho^4}-1) as sidelobe proxy, AoA/AoD angle, range and velocity estimation errors (p. 4-5).
complexity: Table I: 33,792 FLOPs for the four-layer transmit network; 0.0019 s to modulate 1000 symbols on a MacBook M1 CPU (p. 2).
q1_support: p. 2: "Considering multi-path effects, the baseband channel matrix in the time domain described in (1) can be given by"; Eq. (4) is a custom L-path model, and no 3GPP, QuaDRiGa, COST 2100, DeepMIMO or measured data is mentioned.
q2_support: p. 3: "our parameter settings for the channel of K tested symbols is set to be different from those of the training"; this is a 1.5% perturbation of the path parameters (CSI error), not a new scenario, band, array size or dataset.
q3_support: p. 4: "Our constellation outperforms 64-QAM in terms of SER when the weight factor is below 0.6"; the only baselines are 64-QAM and 64-PSK (Figs. 3, 4, 6), with no earlier learned constellation or ISAC method.
q4_support: p. 2: "we use the floating point operations (FLOPs) to quantify the computational costs"; Table I gives 33,792 FLOPs and 0.0019 s for 1000 symbols.
q5_support: p. 4: "we conduct Monte Carlo simulations using 1000 random channel realizations"; the data are self-simulated, and the paper gives no code or data link and uses no public dataset.
notes: Area 5 wins over area 1 because the learned encoder designs the constellation (waveform) for joint sensing and communication, while the transformer receiver comes from the authors' earlier work [9]. Antenna counts of the simulation are not stated, but the model is MIMO-OFDM with Nr x Nt antennas and AoA/AoD estimation (p. 1-2, 5), so the single-antenna exclusion does not apply. q2 is 0 because the 1.5% parameter perturbation is a CSI-error test, which the rules exclude. Table I values were read from the page image (p. 2).
